title: VibeMaker Studio Story
intro: Full-screen scroll story for the landing hero.

slides.headline: Start Something That's Yours.
slides.body: Launch your own apps studio in seconds — right on your Mac.

slides.headline: Make It Yours.
slides.body: Your logo, your colors, your typography. Apps that actually look like your product.

slides.headline: Light or Dark.
slides.body: Brand once, see it shine in both modes — powered by the Vibekit theme engine.

slides.headline: From Mac to Web.
slides.body: Hit publish, copy your live URL, and share. No extra dashboards, no deployment puzzle.

slides.headline: Write Beautifully.
slides.body: A block-based editor that feels native, fast, and alive — with live preview beside your words.

slides.headline: Grow What You Build.
slides.body: Plugins, automations, imports, analytics — everything you need to grow a serious audience.
